title: Removed companion projects come back after restart
brief:
In the Docket companion UI (`ui/`), removing a project with "Remove from list" in the project menu works until the companion is restarted; after a restart the removed project is listed again.

Expected behavior: a removed project stays out of the list across companion restarts, while every other saved project, including projects added after the removal, is still listed. Adding a removed project again works and persists. The starting project still cannot be removed. Keep the saved-list format and its private file permissions.

How to run it: `cd ui && npm start -- --workspace /absolute/project` starts the companion and prints a private local URL.
The project list is saved to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/docket-ui/projects.json` (default `~/.local/state/docket-ui/projects.json`).
Use a private `XDG_STATE_HOME` and disposable projects for any manual check rather than your real companion state.
Prerequisites are Node.js 22+, Python 3.11+ as `python3`, and the companion's npm dependencies (`cd ui && npm ci`).
`cd ui && npm test` runs the companion's unit tests.
criteria: A project removed from the list is not listed after a companion restart.
Every other saved project, including one added again after removal, is still listed after a restart.
The starting project cannot be removed, and the saved list keeps its format and private permissions.
